dialogue.origin: こんばんは。本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Good evening. I look forward to our session today.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Good evening. Likewise.

dialogue.origin: お時間になったら始めるのでよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Shall we begin at our scheduled time?

dialogue.origin: それとも少し早いですが始めてしまいますか？
dialogue.content: Or would you prefer to start a little early?

dialogue.origin: はい、OKです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.origin: ↑いつでもOKです
dialogue.content: I'm ready whenever you are.

dialogue.origin: わざわざありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your flexibility.

dialogue.origin: では始めましょう。
dialogue.content: Then, let's begin.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは相談員です。本日はどういったご相談でしょうか。
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm your counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 会社に行くのが嫌になってきました
dialogue.content: I'm starting to dread going to work.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: いつ頃からそう感じるのでしょう。
dialogue.content: About how long have you been feeling that way?

dialogue.origin: 実は8月終わり頃にも体調を崩しまして
dialogue.content: Actually, I also got sick around the end of August.

dialogue.origin: ええ。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 2ヶ月休んで復帰しましたが
dialogue.content: I took two months off and returned to work, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: また今辛くなってきました
dialogue.content: It's becoming difficult again now.

dialogue.origin: それは大変でしたね。。。
dialogue.content: That must have been very hard for you...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: つらい原因をお聞きしてもよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.content: May I ask what you feel is causing the distress?

dialogue.origin: 仕事についていけないというか、上司の言っている意味も分からないんですよね
dialogue.content: It's like I can't keep up with my work, and I don't even understand what my boss means.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それはおつらいですね。。。
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult for you...

dialogue.origin: はい、もう駄目かな…
dialogue.content: Yes, I feel like I might be at my limit...

dialogue.origin: 体調崩したのはストレスが原因と言ったとこでしょうか。。。
dialogue.content: Would you say the health issues were caused by stress?

dialogue.origin: そうだと思います
dialogue.content: I think so.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね、
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: つらいと思いながらも今はお仕事にいっているのですね。
dialogue.content: So you're still going to work even though it's so difficult.

dialogue.origin: 何とか行ってますが、帰ってくるとぐったりです
dialogue.content: I manage to go somehow, but I'm exhausted when I get home.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。心の疲れは尋常じゃないですよね。
dialogue.content: I can imagine. Emotional exhaustion can be overwhelming.

dialogue.origin: それでも働いているのはえらいと思います。
dialogue.content: I think it's admirable that you're still working despite that.

dialogue.origin: はい、イライラが止まらず、体がおかしくなりそうです
dialogue.content: Yes, I can't stop feeling irritable, and I feel like my body is breaking down.

dialogue.origin: それは大変ですね。。。転職などは考えたことないのですか？
dialogue.content: That sounds very tough... Have you ever thought about changing jobs?

dialogue.origin: まだ入社したばかりなので、
dialogue.content: I've only just joined the company, so...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ようやくいい会社に就職できたと思ったのに
dialogue.content: And just when I thought I'd finally gotten a job at a good company...

dialogue.origin: はい、、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: こんなことになるなんて思いませんでした
dialogue.content: I never imagined it would turn out like this.

dialogue.origin: 希望で満ちていたのに、それは悲しいですね。。。
dialogue.content: After you were so full of hope, that must be very sad...

dialogue.origin: はい、悲しいです
dialogue.content: Yes, it is sad.

dialogue.origin: 同時に入社した同期の方などはいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.content: Are there any colleagues who joined the company at the same time as you?

dialogue.origin: はい、います
dialogue.content: Yes, there are.

dialogue.origin: その方々のお仕事ぶりはどうですか？
dialogue.content: How are they doing with their work?

dialogue.origin: 同じように苦戦していそうですか？
dialogue.content: Do they seem to be struggling similarly?

dialogue.origin: それぞれ苦労はしているようですが
dialogue.content: It seems they each have their own struggles, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 頑張っています
dialogue.content: they're pushing through.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ご相談者様の悩みは、同期の方など周りの方に相談されたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you ever discussed your worries with your colleagues or anyone else around you?

dialogue.origin: はいでも仕事内容も違いますし、愚痴を聞いてもらうだけなので、悪いなと思うようになりました
dialogue.content: Yes, but our job duties are different, and it feels like I'm just venting, so I started to feel bad about it.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。。。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: ご相談者様がその方々の悩みなど聞く機会はあるのですか？
dialogue.content: Do you ever have opportunities to listen to their worries?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、みんな悩みはあるので、聞くことはあります
dialogue.content: Well, yes, everyone has their own worries, so sometimes I listen.

dialogue.origin: ではお互いさまといった感じですね。
dialogue.content: So it sounds like it goes both ways, then.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 私は辞めた方がいいのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Should I quit?

dialogue.origin: ご相談者様に味方がいると知れて安心しました。
dialogue.content: I'm relieved to know that you have people on your side.

dialogue.origin: かぶってしまいましたすみません。
dialogue.content: Sorry, our messages overlapped.

dialogue.origin: いいえ
dialogue.content: Not at all.

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です
dialogue.content: It's okay.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。ご相談者様は辞めたいと思っているのですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. Do you feel like you want to quit?

dialogue.origin: んーせっかく大手に就職できたのに、こんなことで辞めるのはもったいないという気持ちもあつたり
dialogue.content: Hmm... I feel like it would be a waste to quit over something like this, especially since I finally got a job at a major company.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 親が就職を喜んでくれたので、辞めづらいというのもあります
dialogue.content: Also, my parents were so happy that I got this job, which makes it hard to quit.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でも限界かな…
dialogue.content: But I think I'm at my limit...

dialogue.origin: そう感じるのですね・・・
dialogue.content: That's how you're feeling...

dialogue.origin: はい、どうしたらいいのでしょう？
dialogue.content: Yes, what should I do?

dialogue.origin: 答えにくければ答えなくてもよいのですが、
dialogue.content: You don't have to answer if it's difficult for you, but,

dialogue.origin: この件で病院など受診はしましたか？
dialogue.content: have you seen a doctor about this?

dialogue.origin: はい、休職する際
dialogue.content: Yes, when I took a leave of absence,

dialogue.origin: 受診しました
dialogue.content: I saw a doctor.

dialogue.origin: お医者様はなんと？
dialogue.content: What did the doctor say?

dialogue.origin: 辞めたほうがいいなどおっしゃてましたか？
dialogue.content: Did they suggest that you should quit, for example?

dialogue.origin: 軽く鬱症状とのことでした
dialogue.content: They said I had mild symptoms of depression.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 会社のことについては何も
dialogue.content: They didn't say anything about the company.

dialogue.origin: では「危険な状態だから入院・退職など考えなさい」というような感じではなかったのですね。
dialogue.content: So it wasn't a situation where they said, 'You're in a dangerous state, you should consider hospitalization or quitting,' or anything like that.

dialogue.origin: 一切会社のことは触れず、ただ薬を処方してくれただけで
dialogue.content: They didn't mention the company at all, just prescribed me some medication.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。それを聞けて安心しました。
dialogue.content: I see. I'm relieved to hear that.

dialogue.origin: あとはゆっくり休んで、回復してきたら旅行でも行ったら？と言われました
dialogue.content: They also told me to rest well, and that maybe I should go on a trip once I start to recover.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 私は医者ではないので、
dialogue.content: I'm not a doctor, so,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 体調に関してのコメントはできないですが、
dialogue.content: so I can't comment on your medical condition,

dialogue.origin: まずご自身のお体を大切にしてあげてください。
dialogue.content: first and foremost, please take good care of your body.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I will.

dialogue.origin: それを踏まえて一緒にどうしていくか考えていきましょう＾＾
dialogue.content: With that in mind, let's think together about how to move forward.

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 上司の言っていることがわからないとのことですが、
dialogue.content: You mentioned that you don't understand what your boss is saying.

dialogue.origin: これは難しくてでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is it because it's too difficult?

dialogue.origin: それとも感情的に怒られるからなどでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Or is it because they get angry and emotional?

dialogue.origin: 難しいというより、言ってる意味が分からない感じです
dialogue.content: It's not so much that it's difficult, but more that I don't understand what they mean.

dialogue.origin: 支離滅裂という感じでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Does it feel incoherent?

dialogue.origin: 怒られはしません
dialogue.content: They don't get angry.

dialogue.origin: 怒られはしないのですね。
dialogue.content: So they don't get angry at you.

dialogue.origin: 例えば、仕事はやって覚えろ　というのですが
dialogue.content: For example, they say, 'You learn the job by doing it,' but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: そもそも、きちんと教えられてないのにどうやってやるの？って感じです
dialogue.content: it's like, how am I supposed to do it if I haven't been taught properly in the first place?

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。。。
dialogue.content: That makes sense...

dialogue.origin: 意味が分かりません
dialogue.content: It doesn't make any sense.

dialogue.origin: 確かにやって覚えていく部分はありますが、ベースがないと困りますよね。
dialogue.content: While it's true that some parts are learned by doing, it's difficult when you don't have the fundamentals, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい、層なんです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's exactly it.

dialogue.origin: そういった感じの「意味が分からない」なのですね。
dialogue.content: So that's the kind of 'not making sense' you meant.

dialogue.origin: 同じ部署内に、相談や質問できる先輩などはいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: Is there a senior colleague in your department whom you can consult or ask questions?

dialogue.origin: はい、これどうしたらいいんでしようか？
dialogue.content: Yes... What am I supposed to do?

dialogue.origin: 先輩がいて、
dialogue.content: There's a senior colleague,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: その人から仕事を教えてもらえることになっていますが
dialogue.content: and I'm supposed to be learning the job from them, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 簡単なマニュアルをわたされて
dialogue.content: I was just handed a simple manual...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: まず読むように言われて
dialogue.content: ...and told to read it first.

dialogue.origin: ほぼ放置なのですね。。。
dialogue.content: So you're mostly left on your own...

dialogue.origin: 実際やってみると
dialogue.content: When I actually try doing it,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: マニュアルに書かれてないことが結構出てくるんですよね
dialogue.content: a lot of things come up that aren't in the manual.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それを質問して教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: Can you ask about those things and get an explanation?

dialogue.origin: 最初は教えてもらってましたが、だんだんその人も一人でたくさんの仕事を抱えているので
dialogue.content: They taught me at first, but gradually, since they're handling so much work by themselves...

dialogue.origin: 聞きにくくなりました
dialogue.content: ...it became difficult to ask.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。。。
dialogue.content: I understand...

dialogue.origin: 確かにそれは聞くのが申し訳なくなってしまいますね。。。
dialogue.content: I can see how you'd start to feel bad about asking...

dialogue.origin: この間は
dialogue.content: The other day,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 先輩か半日会議で不在で
dialogue.content: my senior was out for a half-day meeting,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: ずっとぼーっとしてました
dialogue.content: and I just sat there with nothing to do the whole time.

dialogue.origin: 質問する相手がいなくてといったことでしょうか
dialogue.content: Because you had no one to ask?

dialogue.origin: はいこの状態でどうやって、やって覚えるの？って思っちゃいます
dialogue.content: Yes. It makes me wonder, how am I supposed to 'learn by doing' in this situation?

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。。。
dialogue.content: That makes sense...

dialogue.origin: そういった現状を会社に言う場所はありますか？
dialogue.content: Is there a place in the company where you can report this kind of situation?

dialogue.origin: 意味わかんないです
dialogue.content: I don't understand what you mean.

dialogue.origin: 相談室などといったものはありますか？
dialogue.content: Is there something like a counseling office?

dialogue.origin: 入社時の研修で説明ありました
dialogue.content: They explained about it during the new employee training.

dialogue.origin: そこには相談してみましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you tried consulting with them?

dialogue.origin: 復社時にカウンセラーに少し会いました
dialogue.content: I met briefly with a counselor when I returned to work.

dialogue.origin: 何か改善はされそうな雰囲気ありましたか？
dialogue.content: Did it seem like anything might improve?

dialogue.origin: その時は体調に問題ないか聞かれた程度でしたが、
dialogue.content: At that time, they mostly just asked if I was having any health problems, but,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: カウンセラーは話しやすかったです
dialogue.content: but the counselor was easy to talk to.

dialogue.origin: それはよかったです＾＾
dialogue.content: I'm glad to hear that.

dialogue.origin: もしもの話で質問しますが、
dialogue.content: May I ask a hypothetical question?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Sure.

dialogue.origin: 親御さんが就職喜んでくれたからやめにくいという事実は考えないとして
dialogue.content: Setting aside the fact that your parents were happy about your job and that makes it hard to quit,

dialogue.origin: 単純に今の仕事を続けるやりがいや頑張りがいは感じますか？
dialogue.content: do you feel any sense of purpose or motivation to continue with your current work?

dialogue.origin: んー正直今のところあまり感じません
dialogue.content: Hmm... to be honest, I don't really feel much of that right now.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: では逆に親御さんの立場で考えてみてください。
dialogue.content: Then, try to think about it from your parents' perspective.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 自分の子供がいい会社でたくさん稼ぐが、心がすり減っている姿と
dialogue.content: Imagine your child earning a lot at a good company but being emotionally worn down,

dialogue.origin: かせぎは少ないが生き生きと楽しそうに働いている姿
dialogue.content: versus earning less but working with energy and enjoyment.

dialogue.origin: ご相談者様ならどっちの子の姿を見たいでしょうか。
dialogue.content: If it were you, which child would you rather see?

dialogue.origin: まぁ　生き生きとしている方がいいかもですね
dialogue.content: Well, I suppose the one who is full of life would be better.

dialogue.origin: ではご相談者様のご両親もそう思うのではないでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Then don't you think your parents might feel the same way?

dialogue.origin: んーどうでしょうか
dialogue.content: Hmm, I'm not sure.

dialogue.origin: うちの親は
dialogue.content: My parents...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 途中であきらめとかが大嫌いなところがあるので
dialogue.content: ...really hate it when people give up halfway through.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 何と言うか分かりません
dialogue.content: I don't know what they would say.

dialogue.origin: お話を聞いていると、
dialogue.content: From what you've shared,

dialogue.origin: ただ私は体をこのまま壊すのは嫌です
dialogue.content: But I don't want to keep ruining my health like this.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。ご相談者様はご自分がつらいのに、
dialogue.content: I understand. Even though you're the one going through a hard time,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 親、同期、先輩、周りのことを考えられるお優しい方だと感じました。
dialogue.content: I feel that you are a very kind person who thinks about your parents, colleagues, seniors, and everyone around you.

dialogue.origin: 有難うございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: なのでご自分にも優しくして、周りに甘えてもいいのでは？と思いました。
dialogue.content: That's why I think it's okay to be kinder to yourself and allow yourself to rely on others a bit more.

dialogue.origin: 私は自分に厳しいのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Am I being too hard on myself?

dialogue.origin: 厳しいというより甘え下手といった感じでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Less 'hard on yourself' and more 'not very good at allowing yourself to rely on others,' perhaps.

dialogue.origin: 私からの提案なのですが
dialogue.content: May I offer a suggestion?

dialogue.origin: 甘え下手？
dialogue.content: Not good at relying on others?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: もし仕事を続けるなら「早く仕事覚えて先輩の手伝いできるために、今はご迷惑おかけします！」といった気持ちで先輩に質問してみてはいかがでしょう？
dialogue.content: If you decide to continue with the job, how about trying to ask your senior questions with the mindset of, 'I'm sorry to trouble you now, but it's so I can learn the job quickly and be able to help you!'?

dialogue.origin: だれにでも初めてはあるので、先輩もきっと面倒みてくれるでしょう。
dialogue.content: Everyone is a beginner at some point, so I'm sure your senior will look after you.

dialogue.origin: もしやめるなら、
dialogue.content: If you decide to quit,

dialogue.origin: 「今の会社の上司がひどくてこのままでは体がもたない」と正直に言って、逃げではなく前向きに次を見据えて転職する。
dialogue.content: be honest and say, 'My boss at this company is terrible, and my health can't take it anymore,' and then change jobs not as an escape, but as a positive step toward the future.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: この考え方はどうでしょうか。
dialogue.content: What do you think of this way of thinking?

dialogue.origin: どちらを選択するかはご相談者様本人ですが、どちらにせよお気持ちが楽になればよいと思ったのですが・・・
dialogue.content: The choice is yours, but I hope either way it eases your mind...

dialogue.origin: 先輩は忙しそうなので、声かけにくいのですか、、
dialogue.content: My senior seems so busy, so it's hard to approach them...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 振り切って質問したら大丈夫　ということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Are you saying it would be okay if I just push past that feeling and ask?

dialogue.origin: 「お忙しいところすみません。マニュアルだけではわからないところが・・・」といった感じで聞いてみてはどうでしょう。
dialogue.content: How about asking something like, "I'm sorry to bother you while you're busy. There are parts I can't understand from the manual alone..."?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、切り込んでいけば教えてくれるかもしれませんね。先輩は悪い人ではないので…
dialogue.content: You're right, if I just take the plunge and ask, they might teach me. My senior isn't a bad person...

dialogue.origin: 一から百まで聞いていたら足手まといですが、わからないところだけなら平気だと思いますが、どうでしょう？
dialogue.content: If you were asking about everything from A to Z, it would be a hindrance, but I think it's fine if it's just the parts you don't understand. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 分からないところだけ聞く　ですね。こそにまだ難しさを少し感じるのでますが、、やってみようかと思います
dialogue.content: Just ask about the parts I don't understand... right. I still feel a little hesitant about that, but I think I'll try to do it.

dialogue.origin: 完全な答えを出せずに申し訳ないです。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry I couldn't give you a definitive answer.

dialogue.origin: まずはそこから始めてみてください。もちろん体調も考え無理せずに。
dialogue.content: Please try starting from there. And of course, listen to your body and don't push yourself too hard.

dialogue.origin: いえ、ややこしい相談ですみません
dialogue.content: No, I'm sorry for such a complicated issue.

dialogue.origin: はい、体は大事にしたあです
dialogue.content: Yes, I want to take care of my body.

dialogue.origin: とんでもございません。そろそろお時間になりますが、ほかに何かお聞きしたいことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Not at all. Our time is almost up, but is there anything else you would like to ask?

dialogue.origin: いえ、大丈夫です
dialogue.content: No, I'm fine.

dialogue.origin: すぐに解決できる問題ではないと思います。またつらくなったり、行き詰ったら相談に来てください。
